Update on ENTR-601-45 On October 14, 2026, the Company announced positive topline data from Cohort 1 of the double-blind, placebo-controlled, multiple ascending dose (MAD) portion of the Phase 1/2 ELEVATE-45-201 clinical study of ENTR-601-45 in ambulatory participants with a confirmed mutation in the DMD gene amenable to exon 45 skipping.

Highlights from the topline results of Cohort 1 of ELEVATE-45-201 include: Dystrophin measured by western blot and normalized to MHC; Dystrophin values are actual observed values, including values <LLOQ; Two participants in the ENTR-601-45 group had baseline dystrophin levels <LLOQ and >LOD; LLOQ for dystrophin was 0.25%; LOD for dystrophin was 0.1%; Biopsy performed at baseline; LLOQ: Lower limit of quantification; LOD: Limit of detection; MHC: Myosin heavy chain.
